activities.title: Join in.
activities.intro: There's more than music around Zomaar Zomert. Two big ones: the Zomaar Bike on Friday and the Zomaar Run on Sunday. Plus paella, pétanque and a quiz.

bike.title: Zomaar Bike
bike.body: Mountain bike and gravel through the green western edge of Brussels. Sign up in advance or on site, in advance is the smart move.

run.title: Zomaar Run
run.body: Running race over the Keperenberg, 7 or 14 km with chip timing. Sign up in advance or on site, in advance is the smart move.

paella.title: Paella
paella.body: Sunday from 12:00 to 15:00, at long tables with the neighbours as company. Ludo happily dishes his freshly made paella onto your plate. For the impatient little ones there's plenty of side entertainment. Signing up in advance is required, so we can estimate portions better and cut down on waste. You pay on site, and a sangria is on us.

petanque.title: Pétanque
petanque.body: Saturday at 12:30, around four hours of boules on the field next to the tent. An afternoon somewhere between relaxed and competitive, a cold beer within reach. Signing up in advance is required, team spots are limited. On site it's €10 per person, bring your own pétanque set. Once it's full it's full, so don't wait too long.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.body: Sunday evening, the quiet close of the weekend. Registration from 19:30, the quiz itself runs 20:00 to 23:00. You can only sign up on site, €10 per team. Expect an evening of questions, the odd trick one and prizes for the sharpest tables. Pick a fun team name and come rack your brains.
